journey.title: From file to stage in 3 steps
journey.subtitle: No spreadsheets, no loose PDFs, no memorizing lyrics by heart.
journey.step1Desc: Paste or type the lyrics with chords — your library stays organized and ready for any rehearsal.
journey.step2Desc: Mark each line at the right moment in the reference track, just once per song.
journey.step3Desc: Turn on karaoke mode and let the screen follow the band on its own, line by line, from the first chord to the last.

howItWorks.title: How it works, step by step
howItWorks.subtitle: A workflow built for musicians — not for programmers.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Add your setlist's songs with lyrics, chords, sections (intro, chorus, solo), and rehearsal notes.
howItWorks.step2Title: Record or upload the reference audio
howItWorks.step2Desc: Upload the song's audio file — the system uses it to calculate the sync timing.
howItWorks.step3Desc: In the sync editor, play the track and mark the exact moment of each line and every chord change.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Group the show's songs into shareable setlists for the rest of the band, in the order you'll play them.
howItWorks.step5Title: Play in karaoke or scroll mode
howItWorks.step5Desc: On stage, choose line-by-line mode synced to the audio, or continuous scroll mode at your own pace.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What most people ask before getting started.
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to play an instrument to use it?
faq.a1: No. Whoever sings or leads the show can also use the platform to follow the lyrics and song order — karaoke mode helps anyone keep pace.
faq.a2: Yes, the interface adapts to phone and tablet screens, as well as desktop. Many bands run a tablet on a stand during the show.
faq.a3: Yes, there's no commitment. You can cancel your subscription anytime, right from your account settings.
faq.a4: Your chord sheets and setlists are private by default. They're only visible to whoever you share the link with — you decide what to share.
faq.q5: Do I need internet on stage to use karaoke mode?
faq.a5: You'll want a connection to load the song and its sync data before you go on stage; after that, the performance runs without depending on a stable connection.
faq.q6: Can I use it with any instrument?
faq.a6: Yes. Chord sheets work for any harmonic instrument, and the chord dictionary includes diagrams for guitar, keyboard, and ukulele.
faq.q7: Does the free trial require a credit card?
faq.a7: No. You get 14 days free without entering any card — just create your account and start using it.
